course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Design a 10 ft single angel tension member to support a dead tensile working load of 30 k and live tensile working load of 40 k. The member is to be connected to one leg only with 7/8 -in bolt (at least four in a line 3 in a on center). Assume that only one bolt is to be located at any one cross section. Use A 36 steel with $F y = 4 0$ Ksi and $F _ { u } = 6 0 ~ \mathsf { K s i }$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
